data.title: 小鞠知花 · 晨光棉被里的仓鼠式甜梦
data.description: 早晨的阳光穿透窗纱洒在白被单上。像只小仓鼠一样整个人蜷缩在你怀里的知花，小脸贴着你的锁骨，双手死死攥着你的衣襟，嘴角挂着安心甜笑，发出软绵绵的梦呓。
data.location: bright warm morning bedroom with rumpled white duvet
data.action: 像只小仓鼠一样整个人蜷缩在你怀里的知花，小脸贴着你的锁骨，双手死死攥着你的衣襟
data.lighting: radiant golden morning sunbeams pouring across white bedspread
data.promptProse: Washed in gentle morning sunlight through sheer bedroom curtains, Chika tucks her face peacefully against her partner's collarbone with both small hands gripping his shirt hem in a contented morning doze.
data.animaCaption: Curled snugly like a sleepy hamster against her partner's collarbone across the sunlit white bedsheets, she clutches his shirt fabric with both hands and smiles serenely in her pastel-pink lace-trimmed cotton camisole and soft lounge shorts.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a delicate pastel-pink cotton camisole with thin spaghetti straps and scalloped lace trim over matching soft lounge shorts beneath the rumpled white sheets.
